root_cause: ADMIN_APPS_BASE_URL was not supplied from the isolated run allocation before Django settings initialization. backend.settings.py supplied a localhost default, and integration.client.AdminAppsClient supplied a second localhost default when the settings mapping was absent.
corrected_resolution_path: resource allocation manifest provides the isolated AdminApps host port
the authorized runner injects ADMIN_APPS_BASE_URL before Django settings initialization
backend.settings.ADMIN_APPS_INTEGRATION.BASE_URL reads that value without a localhost default
integration.client.AdminAppsClient uses the same BASE_URL for entitlement and all AdminApps calls

fallback_behavior.missing_or_malformed_endpoint: request is rejected locally and entitlement resolves fail-closed
fallback_behavior.local_entitlement_bypass: not permitted by the QMS command

integrity_impact.required_action: create and verify the normal successor current-integrity generation before future live authorization

exact_next_step: Perform successor current-integrity reconciliation for the protected-source changes; do not authorize a live retry until it passes.
